summary: Wide parking lane on Stanley Terrace, but homes sit 15-20 m behind the kerb.

best_section.where: South kerb of Stanley Terrace, west end of the stretch, below the tree-covered houses

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 15 m and 19 m away on the same side, with a 10 m house near the 0 m end; tree cover screens them.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerbside parallel parking lane beside a wide road, room to pull fully off the traffic lane.
drivers.traffic: Busy two-way street with cars parked on both sides.
drivers.convention: Cars park on both kerbs, so a van is not out of place. 2P limit applies, with resident permits excepted Mon-Fri 7am-7pm.

flags: Steep: about 3.6% grade, max 10% over one 5 m step
2P parking signs, resident permits excepted Mon-Fri 7am-7pm
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy on the south side shades the section; the road is open to the north.
